title: Supply the complete physical periodic Gaussian update with unchanged final rounding
body:
PR5159's complete periodic Gaussian inverse used host-indexed input gathers. This package supplies the actual385-row physical update on the same33-bit grid, preserving genuine wrap couplings and hole192. Eight paid coefficient-layout passes and cyclic input scans feed exact80-bit signed accumulators; each output component is truncated only once after all offsets. The owner preserves borrowed inputs and returns all heads, erases retained scratch, and requires physical consumption of its pending output.

The written successful-domain theorem covers arbitrary admitted signed grid inputs at this fixed geometry. Complete constructor/update/consume instruction vectors and449445 retained cells are recorded. The universal update invoice differs from its zero-input invoice only by at most770 explicit signed-rounding corrections. The275-update error transfer and alternating-owner copy/setup/cleanup allowance are symbolic;275 physical updates were not executed. Host coefficient generation/serialization, variable-width control, literal standalone instruction compilation and complete multiplier admission remain separate. No new kappa.

Validation at13b76bd3c76b315a198136f3ff9d5688ec196f64: normal replay regenerating every original coefficient PASS37.699s; cached optimized Git-free read-only export replay PASS7.268s. Both produce receiptbe3faf4f97d8733edc2db23206da471ff9b3c18f032097fc426a286d3edfe63a. The full770-component endpoint, same-owner zero-data reuse, borrowed bytes/backings, all head/cleanup contracts and semantic mutations pass. Early per-offset rounding changes178 fixture rows. Independent AI proof review and a separate high-magnitude full update pass. Boolean receipt, missingRESULT, missingSOURCES and source-byte mutations reject in0.10s; all23 exported files are restored and byte-compared. Metadata, committed bytes, source history and official22-file export checks pass. Hosted CI is not yet claimed.

Credit Jose Manuel, Vlado Vojdanovski, Jeremy Kothe, Cinna Davis, Mason Hale, Chafik Boukhalfa and the retained numerical/physical lineage. Exact PR5159 captures preserve their notices. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; new work Apache-2.0. The selected frontier and frozen predecessor files are unchanged.
